# OneShotInteractionCreateRequest

Creates a one-shot interaction: one agent takes the task and gives its answer.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent` | [`InteractionAgentBindingInput`](interaction-agent-binding.md#in-a-request) | yes | The agent that takes the task. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The interaction's name, unique within its namespace. Constraints: maxLength: 150, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `prompt` | `string` | yes | What the agents are asked to do. A run's inputs are filled in wherever it says `%%name%%`. Constraints: minLength: 3, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `solutionSchema` | `string \| null` |  | The JSON Schema the answer must match, as JSON text: the run's output is then JSON of that shape. Null: the output is free text. |
| `systemPromptMode` | [`InteractionSystemPromptMode`](interaction-system-prompt-mode.md) | yes | How `systemPrompts` combine with the instructions Maitento gives every agent. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `systemPrompts` | `string[]` | yes | Extra system instructions for every agent in the interaction. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `durationWarningToAi` | `timespan \| null` |  | How long into a run the agents are told that time is running short. Null: they are not told. |
| `durationAutoTermination` | `timespan \| null` |  | The longest a run may take. The run stops with an error when it is reached; time spent waiting for a person does not count. Null: no limit. |
| `contextSettings` | [`InteractionContextSettingsInput`](interaction-context-settings.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | How the conversation is kept within the model's context window, and how many rounds of tool calls an agent may make in one turn. Null: the defaults. |
| `swarm` | [`InteractionSwarmSettingsInput`](interaction-swarm-settings.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | The sub-interactions its participants may start. Null: none. |
| `credentialStack` | `string \| null` |  | The credential stack its runs use, by id or name, when their start doesn't name one. Null: the namespace's default stack, then your tenant's. A stack that doesn't exist when a run starts refuses the run. |
| `externalOperationsOpenApi` | [`OpenApiExternalOperationBindingInput`](open-api-external-operation-binding.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | Tools from OpenAPI connectors that every agent in the interaction can call, as well as its own tools. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `externalOperationsMcp` | [`McpExternalOperationBindingInput`](mcp-external-operation-binding.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | Tools from MCP connectors that every agent in the interaction can call, as well as its own tools. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `inputsConnectorAuthenticationSecret` | [`ConnectorAuthenticationSecretInputInput`](connector-authentication-secret-input.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | Run inputs that choose the secret a tool sends with its calls. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `inputsConnectorBinding` | [`ConnectorBindingInputInput`](connector-binding-input.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | Run inputs whose values go straight into a tool's calls, so the model never sees or chooses them. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `inputsPrompt` | [`PromptInputInput`](prompt-input.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | The inputs a run is started with, which the prompt uses as `%%name%%`. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `loom` | [`LoomConfigurationInput`](loom-configuration.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | Long-term memory for the interaction's agents. Null: no memory. |
